relevant_controls_reviewed: A frozen G6 plan contains typed run/case/pair/family/CF/replicate/group identity fields.
The four counterfactual versions and private oracle rows must refer to the same case/CF lineage.
Replicate rows are repeated observations within theory-family clusters, not new independent laws.
design_alignment_review.alignment_conclusion: The repaired validator now rejects type coercion and oracle/plan CF misalignment before the family-clustered paired analysis.

before_repair.command: Read-only probes using replicate='0' or True and private case cf_type=CF2 while the plan case is CF1
before_repair.result: FAIL_OPEN: malformed typed/alignment fields were accepted

after_repair.command: Read-only invalid replicate, invalid identifier, and private CF mismatch probes
after_repair.result: All malformed inputs fail closed with explicit schema/alignment errors

repair.change: Added strict nonempty plan identity checks, integer/non-boolean replicate checks, same-case CF consistency, and private-oracle CF/decision alignment checks.

real_corrected_input_probe.command: Read-only validate_statistical_inputs on corrected G6 plan/private/responses with formal dimensions
real_corrected_input_probe.result: PASS: 552 plan rows, 92 private rows, 552 response rows, replicate values [0,1,2], response status completed, and no schema/alignment error

findings.title: G6 statistical input validation coerced malformed replicate and oracle alignment fields
findings.evidence: The pre-repair validator coerced replicate through int() and did not compare private oracle cf_type with the plan case CF.
findings.remediation: Reject malformed typed fields and private-oracle CF/decision misalignment before analysis.
